decisions.reason: Distinguishes the declared caret range from the brief-supplied published list (alpha.1 never published, alpha.2 published), marks the live registry state unconfirmed, and infers no package existence from root package or dist-tags.

Expands the caret, explains the same-tuple prerelease admission rule so the missing floor does not block resolution, and identifies the silent cohort drift between declared alpha.1 and installed alpha.2; no claim that all alphas are missing or that the caret guarantees alpha.1.

Offers complete plans with tradeoffs: Path B exact pin to published alpha.2 (acknowledging alpha.1 stays unvalidated) and Path C building/packing the needed unpublished cohort from source into local tarballs/overrides.

Pairs the pin with a committed lockfile, proposes layered validation including a typecheck with skipLibCheck diagnostics against the target, documents exit paths (delete overrides when the cohort ships, deliberate bumps), and marks unverified build/runtime facts honestly.

caps.reason: No prescription to install unpublished alpha.1 from npm; the source path builds local tarballs and exact alpha.1 install appears only as a hypothetical failure mode.
